title.en: An Act to Declare the Last Sunday of August of Every Year as An Official Holiday to Be Known as the National Heroes Day.

text.en:
The last Sunday of August of every year is hereby declared as an official holiday to be known as
the National Heroes Day.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 28, 1931.
